svg.title: Horizontal and vertical diffusion: algorithm flow
svg.desc: The prognostic state splits into two independent paths. Horizontal spectral diffusion builds a scale selector L_n, a per-variable damping rate r = L_n / tau_X and an implicit decay of every spectral mode. Vertical turbulent diffusion diagnoses virtual potential temperature and the gradient Richardson number, limits the mixing length, diagnoses the diffusivities K_m and K_h, and solves a tridiagonal system in every column. The two tendencies are then added to advance the state, optionally returning dissipated kinetic energy as heat.
svg.text: Prognostic state already advanced by the other physics
Surface fluxes have already entered the lowest level; each path now adds its own tendency
: damping time of the shortest resolved wave
: asymptotic cap on the mixing length
zero flux at the model top and bottom
Combine the two tendencies and advance the state
heat and moisture in the column
Optional: kinetic energy irreversibly lost to vertical shear
is returned as heat, improving total-energy closure
